_note: The Everyday Mirror (rk-everyday-mirror-instrument-draft.md, Draft 0.1). Forced-choice lifestyle instrument: 28 Block A position items + 21 Block B priority comparisons. DEVELOPMENTAL and NOT YET DESIRABILITY PRE-TESTED — see `pretest` below. `option_a` is always the item's named FIRST pole; that mapping is for scoring only and must never be shown. Presentation side is randomised per session and stored in the session's presentation.side_map.

pretest.requirement: 20-30 raters per option on 'which would you rather others thought about you'. Any pair splitting worse than 65/35 must be rewritten before this instrument may anchor a reading.
pretest.consequence: Until this runs, unmatched pairs may behave as a Likert scale with extra steps. The instrument contributes to reads; it never anchors one alone.

pace.descriptor: how much of the week is planned
